title: Encoded optional-index decoder
summary: Executes the compiler's zero-or-index-plus-one decoder and records the exact destination-local update in a named frame.
premises: A checked leanexe.option.encoded-index.v1 equality for the complete six-top-level-instruction decoder region
A source local containing the encoded UInt64 word
Two consecutive valid scratch locals and one valid destination local, all in the internal-local portion of the frame
result: The exact decoder reaches resultFrame with the destination local equal to zero when the encoded value is zero and equal to the encoded value minus one otherwise.
